series.summary: Kerala has proposed a five-year tariff framework with rules for BESS, PSP, including efficiency, availability and grid-forming requirements.

series.title: Volkswagen’s new LFP battery JVs with Gotion will adjust EV and BESS cell production split based on demand

series.title: FERC chair slams PJM ‘mess’ as country’s largest grid operator delays power auction
series.summary: PJM had planned to accept offers for backstop power supplies from Sept. 30 through Oct. 21 after falling short of its reserve margin targets amid aggressive data center load growth. But FERC only partially approved its plan, zeroing in on cost allocation concerns.

series.title: Facilities are using 48E investment tax credits to make energy projects pencil out
series.summary: Most commonly, building operators are using the tax credit to install battery storage systems that can leverage lower-cost electricity rates, says an executive with tax-credit consulting firm Alliant.

series.title: Queensland’s CleanCo credits battery storage boom as Australian state records 40% wholesale electricity price drop
series.summary: Queensland's average wholesale electricity price fell by 40% in the 2025-26 financial year, a drop CleanCo Queensland attributes to BESS.
